commonPrompt: Redesign a finished Kingdom Come premium painterly dark-fantasy loot icon, NOT a realistic museum weapon or product photograph. The supplied approved Oathbound and Eclipse icons establish painterly finish, strong material detail, magical desirability, charcoal backdrop and compact framing. Hudson is ONLY a QUALITY reference: absolutely no rainbow, no multicolored/prismatic blade, no copying its shape, guard, gem or magical treatment. Create a genuinely NEW physical design, not an old weapon recolored. One dominant weapon, entire weapon intact including tips, grip and pommel, diagonal lower-left to upper-right, centered, 10% natural charcoal clearance on every side so a 60x60 or 76x76 crop retains its silhouette. Weapon occupies about 80% of square image; sufficiently broad masses for thumbnail recognition. SAME collection backdrop: near-black neutral/cool charcoal, subtle smoky painterly texture, uniformly dark corners, no warm brown/orange backdrop, no scene, no border, no vignette/matte/padding, no text, no pedestal, no extra objects. Controlled dramatic edge highlights; internal elemental illumination must light the metal physically, small controlled bloom; background remains subordinate. Rich premium stylized painted fantasy rendering, not flat concept art, not CGI photography. ONE coherent elemental color family only. Output square 1024x1024.

entries.name: Marchwatch Spear
entries.brief: A broad ice-leaf spearhead made from two unequal cold-iron wings clasping a frosted crystal wedge. One projecting lower tine and a short transverse frost-rune collar create a memorable asymmetric partizan silhouette. Dark wrapped shaft, carved mountain-iron ferrule. Fine ice-blue rune seams within the head, restrained white-cold edge lighting, no large aura. A desirable first regional magical weapon, clearly simpler than the elite artifacts.

entries.name: Fenwarden Billhook
entries.brief: A compact eerie billhook, NOT a scythe: one exaggerated inward hooked cutting blade curves from a gnarled ancient-metal ferrule into a claw-shaped silver crescent. An open teardrop recess is bridged by tiny root-like metal ribs clasping a spectral teal fenstone. Tarnished silver and black bog iron, flowing fen-runes on the inner edge. Concentrated emerald-teal light shines through the rootwork and cutting throat; the hooked physical outline must remain readable without any glow.

entries.name: Sunscar Maul
entries.brief: An imposing short-handled copper-and-black maul with a broad angular stepped hammerhead shaped as a truncated desert sun pyramid. Two offset solid bronze striking cheeks lock around a narrow molten-amber core, exposed through deeply engraved zigzag channels. A small blunt back-beak and angular wrapped handle distinguish it from a generic rectangular hammer. Geometric desert relief, dark oxidized bronze flats, bright amber reflecting onto copper bevels, never a solid-gold weapon.

entries.name: Frontier Falchion
entries.brief: An aggressive sharply forward-swept falchion, with a cleaver-like flared hooked tip and a deep concave back. Charred forged steel has overlapping black-iron scale construction along the spine; an ember-red seam is trapped BETWEEN structural plates, meeting a glowing red-orange cutting edge. The guard resembles two unequal shattered battlement teeth, dark leather and soot-scarred rivets. A war-torn magical forged weapon, not an ordinary curved sword surrounded by fire.

entries.name: Crownlands War Staff
entries.brief: An unmistakable royal battle staff with a commanding seven-sided lantern-crown head of silver arches, three long blade-like heraldic ribs and a deep sapphire disk suspended inside its open central chamber. A long dark-steel shaft with widely spaced silver collars and an armored pointed butt. Head is broad enough to read at 60px; no mace-ball shape, no ordinary stick. Royal geometric engravings conduct a single deep sapphire-blue light through the head ribs and the upper shaft, disciplined and noble.

entries.name: Blacksteel Warblade
entries.brief: A brutally prestigious broad blacksteel warblade with a stepped seax-like forward point, a thick bowed spine, two deep triangular cut-outs near the hilt and a split forge-channel opening along only its lower cutting bevel. Layered black plates overlap like broken fortress armor, ember-red heat visible inside their joins. A heavy broken-crown iron guard sweeps forward to protect the hand. Internal crimson glow and heated scarlet-orange edge interact with charred metal, no all-over flames or generic straight longsword geometry.

entries.name: Order Marshal Greatsword
entries.brief: A noble broad two-handed greatsword with a disciplined tapering silver blade built from two strong outer cutting rails bridged over a recessed sapphire-blue central fuller. Its sculpted heraldic wing crossguard has a prominent downward lion-mask center, blue enamel inlays, a long dark grip and silver crown pommel. The negative channel is a physical forged feature with blue energy flowing beneath silver bridges, not a faint painted outline. Polished cool silver highlights, restrained but valuable royal-blue light; original balanced monumental silhouette.

entries.name: Highland Claymore
entries.brief: An elite fantasy Highland claymore whose wide leaf-shaped dark-steel blade has a prominent central angular ice ridge rather than a conventional smooth fuller. Long downward-angled quillons terminate in squared raven-beak iron shapes, a broad frost-carved mountain-knot guard and a blocky dark pommel. A cold-white glacial shard is locked into the guard and feeds branching ice-blue engraved channels through the blade. Rugged forged planes, frozen condensed edge-light, meaningful magical construction without a snowstorm.

entries.name: Marshguard Glaive
entries.brief: An elite tall fen glaive with an unusually long flowing crescent blade and a separate smaller hooked root-spur that creates an open eye-shaped gap at its base. Black ancient metal and tarnished silver are woven into organic rootlike reinforcement, holding a luminous spectral-teal oval core off-center inside that eye. The blade has a scalloped inner cutting edge and a tall narrow sweeping tip; the shaft is black iron with silver vine collars. Eerie elegant construction, concentrated emerald-teal channels and mist-touched engraved surfaces, no generic green aura.

entries.name: Sunscar Officer’s Saber
entries.brief: A prestigious desert officer's fantasy saber with a dramatically forward-curving dark-steel kilij blade and a wide flaring yelman tip. A pierced copper sun-wheel knuckle guard curls as a protective half-cage, joined to a hooked bronze pommel and black wrapped hilt. Solar amber is forged into three geometric incised channels following the blade's curvature and a small core inside the wheel guard. Deep dark-steel flats contrast copper ornament and molten-gold edge-light. Architectural desert craftsmanship, a very distinct saber silhouette.

entries.name: Crown Captain’s Halberd
entries.brief: A tall regal silver-and-black halberd with a sweeping heraldic banner-shaped axe blade on one side, a long three-faceted armor-piercing spear above, and a compact forked beak behind. The axes and point meet around an open royal shield-shaped sapphire reliquary. Broad polished steel faces are engraved with narrow luminous deep-blue heraldic channels and fine silver relief. A long square dark shaft and articulated silver collars. Disciplined royal prestige and substantial integrated magical machinery, not a mundane halberd with a blue outline.

entries.name: Mountain Warden’s Zweihander
entries.brief: A genuinely different massive northern ZWEIHANDER: a narrow-waisted, dramatically WAVY FLAMBERGE blade made of dark iron, with exactly three broad asymmetric S-shaped waves on its cutting outline. Long exposed blunt ricasso with two blocky forward parrying lugs. STRAIGHT horizontal iron crossbar guard ending in square hammer-like blocks, no curved horns, no crescent quillons. A cylindrical TWO-HANDED BLACK GRIP with a heavy octagonal iron pommel, no gemstone pommel. A concentrated icy-blue cylindrical glacial core is pinned across the ricasso, feeding irregular frozen fractures into only one of the dark blade's cutting edges. The other edge remains heavy weathered steel, making asymmetry structural. Rigid bolted mountain-iron plates, mist clinging tightly to the metal. Level70 elite magical craftsmanship. Absolutely NOT a broad leaf blade, NOT a central long column of crystals, NOT a diamond crossguard gem, NOT the Highland Claymore or Hudson sword body.

entries.name: Frontier Marshal’s Poleaxe
entries.brief: An elite savage poleaxe with a large split hooked axe wing made from three articulated black-iron blade plates; the opposite side is a brutal short angular pick, and a long diamond-shaped spear rises above. A fractured furnace-red core is visible BETWEEN pinned plates at the weapon's junction, with ember channels leading into the hooked cutting faces. Dark riveted shaft armor and a short rear counterweight, aggressive battlefield construction, asymmetry and meaningful negative spaces. Controlled crimson/orange forging light reflects from the soot-scarred black metal, no blanket flames.

entries.name: Imperial Thronehammer
entries.brief: A severe imperial artifact polehammer with an enormous stepped triangular anvil-head, a broad faceted obsidian striking face, and a long downward-swept needle pick on the rear. The head is constructed as interlocking blackened imperial steel terraces, dark-silver buttresses and deep violet arcane fractures around a recessed vertical void prism. Ancient imperial glyphs are structural incisions, not decorative floating runes. A thick armored shaft, weighty dark pommel and sharply defined edges create endgame status. Powerful concentrated violet light from within the head, restrained corona only near the artifact; no particle cloud.

entries.name: Eclipse Gatehammer
entries.brief: A monumental level-100 void-forged gatehammer with a uniquely huge asymmetric crescent-shaped obsidian head. Three nested structural black-steel arcs form a broken eclipse aperture, enclosing a suspended concentrated violet void heart; one arc broadens into a massive angular striking face, the opposite ends as a long curved counter-spike. Ancient dark-silver imperial braces clamp the separated arc sections together. Thick tapering armored haft and crescent counterweight, exceptional physical construction visible without glow. Deep violet illumination from INSIDE the opening and fractures, elegant controlled corona, crisp silver-black rim highlights. Legendary quality approaching Hudson's polish, entirely different silhouette and single violet family, never rainbow.

framingPrompt: Refine ONLY framing and background of this exact finished Kingdom Come weapon illustration. Keep the weapon's unique physical construction, silhouette, elemental color, material details, saturated magical energy and premium painterly finish unchanged. Pull camera BACK by 35%; ALL of the weapon, all tips, pommel and radiance must be safely inside the central 72% of the square canvas. At least 14% natural dark-charcoal breathing room at every edge, so portrait and wide cover crops cannot cut extremities. Surround the weapon with the same NEUTRAL near-black smoky charcoal backdrop throughout the collection: subtly textured, extremely subdued, neutral gray not warm brown or colored bands, no bright diagonal backdrop. Preserve localized elemental illumination ON metal and its tiny near-object halo; don't dim the weapon or recolor it. Naturally continue painted charcoal atmosphere to every image edge. No matte, artificial border, padding, vignette, blur bars, mirror, stretch, framing lines, text or other objects. Do not redesign or replace the actual weapon. Square image.

rejectedOutputs.reason: Rejected: blade and crescent guard too similar to Highland Claymore; rebuilt with wavy asymmetrical blade, straight block guard and separate parrying lugs.
rejectedOutputs.initialBrief: An imposing elite northern two-hander, built from an asymmetric broad flamberge-like cold-iron blade with two heavy jagged forging ridges and crystalline frost wedged in the deep fractures between them. Double forward parrying lugs, heavy angular crescent crossguard and a long two-handed dark grip. A concentrated icy-blue glacial core joins blade to guard like a bolted frozen mountain heart. Rough dark planes alternate polished cold edges; ice appears physically integrated and load-bearing, not floating snow. Monumental northern craftsmanship with an unforgettable irregular silhouette.
